text: No confirmed tree-cover loss occurred in 2026 on this property. The latest data (as of 2026-11-12) shows a 13.5 ha loss in 2025, but this remains uncorroborated for 2026 due to lack of later observations. The evidence only identifies a *potential* loss in 2025—no persistent change or cause (e.g., deforestation, fire) is established. The asset’s native forest context (per MGAP 2021) and high JRC agreement (98%) suggest the 2025 signal is plausible, but 2026 remains unassessed. Further monitoring is needed to confirm changes beyond 2025.
